title: [Bug 640454] Scope Expense Agent Entra permissions by company
summary: The Expense Agent now manages Microsoft Entra permissions scoped to individual companies, adding company-specific grants on activation and removing them on deactivation while preserving other permissions and disabling the shared application only when no active companies remain.
key_points: Entra permissions are now company-scoped rather than global, with exactly one grant per active company
Existing global grants are preserved when adding company-specific grants during activation
Company grants are cleanly removed during deactivation without affecting global or other-company permissions
The shared Entra application is disabled only when no non-empty company grants exist
Non-SUPER users need Agent - Admin, Expense Mgmt. Admin, SECURITY, and Expense Agent permission sets to manage registrations
quote: always add exactly one current-company Expense Agent permission during activation
